title: 1  York Region
text:
1.3 LHIN


Show code
tbls[["lhin-summary"]] <- lhin |> 
  mutate(
    across(
      matches("amount|cmha|css"), 
      ~ real_dollars(.x, data_year, 2023)
    )
  ) |> 
  left_join(
    fir_data |> 
      filter(
        ut_name == "York R",
      ) |> 
      distinct(data_year = marsyear, pop_york = population, ut_name),
    by = c("data_year")
  ) |> 
  filter(serves_york) |> 
  mutate(
    amount_pc_gap = amount_pc - amount_pc_on,
    total_gap = amount_pc_gap * pop_york
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    summarize(.,
      lhin = "Central",
      data_year = Inf,
      across(
        c(matches("amount_pc$")),
        ~ weighted.mean(.x, pop_lhin, na.rm = TRUE)
      ), 
      across(
        c(matches("amount_pc_on$")),
        ~ weighted.mean(.x, pop_on, na.rm = TRUE)
      ), 
      across(
        c(matches("pop_(lhin|york)")),
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ), 
      .by = c(ut_name)
    )  |> 
    mutate(
      amount_pc_gap = amount_pc - amount_pc_on,
      total_gap = amount_pc_gap * pop_york
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    channel = "Local Health Integration Networks (LHINs)",
    data_year = data_year, 
    data_range = glue::glue("({min(data_year)}-{max(data_year[data_year < Inf])})"),
    headline_gap_pc = amount_pc_gap,
    headline_gap_total = total_gap
  )

tbls[["lhin-summary"]] |> 
  select(
    data_year, 
    amount_pc_on, 
    amount_pc, 
    amount_pc_gap,
    pop_lhin,
    pop_york, 
    total_gap
  ) |> 
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    data_year = "Year",
    amount_pc_on = "Ontario",
    amount_pc = "York",
    amount_pc_gap = "Gap",
    pop_lhin = "Central LHIN",
    pop_york = "York",
    total_gap = "Total Gap"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Provincial Support Per Capita",
    columns = c(matches("^amount_pc"))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Population",
    columns = c(matches("^pop"))
  ) |> 
  gt::fmt_currency(
    columns = c(matches("^(amount|total)")), 
    decimals = 0
  ) |> 
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(
      matches("^pop")
    ), 
    decimals = 0
  ) |> 
  gt::text_replace(
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = c(data_year)), 
    pattern = "Inf",
    replacement = "Average (2017-2020)"
  )

1.4 School Boards


Show code
tbls[["efis-summary"]] <- efis |> 
  filter(
    school_board |> stringr::str_detect("york")
  ) |> 
  left_join(
    fir_data |> 
      filter(
        ut_name == "York R",
      ) |> 
      distinct(data_year = marsyear, population, ut_name),
    by = c("data_year")
  ) |>  
  mutate(
    rev_provincial_pc_gap = rev_provincial_total_gap / population
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    summarize(., 
      data_year = Inf,
      across(
        c(matches("rev_provincial_ps$")),
        ~ weighted.mean(.x, avg_daily_enrolment, na.rm = TRUE)
      ), 
      across(
        c(matches("rev_provincial_ps_avg$")),
        ~ weighted.mean(.x, avg_daily_enrolment_ontario, na.rm = TRUE)
      ), 
      across(
        c(matches("^(avg_daily_enrolment|population)")),
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .by = c(school_board, board_sector, ut_name)
    ) |> 
    mutate(
      rev_provincial_ps_gap = rev_provincial_ps - rev_provincial_ps_avg,
      rev_provincial_total_gap = rev_provincial_ps_gap * avg_daily_enrolment,
      rev_provincial_pc_gap = rev_provincial_total_gap / population,
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    channel = c(
      "Public" = "Public School Boards",
      "Catholic" = "Roman Catholic Separate School Boards"
    )[board_sector],
    data_year = data_year, 
    data_range = glue::glue("({min(data_year)}-{max(data_year[data_year < Inf])})"),
    headline_gap_pc = rev_provincial_pc_gap,
    headline_gap_total = rev_provincial_total_gap
  )

tbls[["efis-summary"]] |> 
  select(
    board_sector,
    data_year, 
    rev_provincial_ps_avg,
    rev_provincial_ps,
    rev_provincial_ps_gap,
    avg_daily_enrolment_ontario,
    avg_daily_enrolment,
    rev_provincial_total_gap,
    population,
    rev_provincial_pc_gap
  ) |> 
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "board_sector") |> 
  gt::cols_label(
    data_year = "Year",
    rev_provincial_ps_avg = "Ontario",
    rev_provincial_ps = "York",
    rev_provincial_ps_gap = "Gap",
    avg_daily_enrolment_ontario = "Ontario",
    avg_daily_enrolment = "York",
    rev_provincial_total_gap = "Total Gap",
    rev_provincial_pc_gap = "Per Capita Gap",
    population = "York Pop."
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "$ Per Student",
    columns = c(matches("^rev_provincial_ps"))
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Avg. Daily Enrolment",
    columns = c(matches("^avg_daily_enrolment"))
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_options(
    row_group.as_column = TRUE
  ) |> 
  gt::fmt_currency(
    columns = c(matches("^rev")), 
    decimals = 0
  ) |> 
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(
      matches("enrolment|population")
    ), 
    decimals = 0
  ) |> 
  gt::text_replace(
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = c(data_year)), 
    pattern = "Inf",
    replacement = "Average (2015-2024)"
  )

text:
1.5 Combined Gap


Show code
tbls[["combined-gap"]] <- tbls[c(
  "fir-summary-core",
  "fir-summary-soc",
  "t3010-summary",
  "lhin-summary",
  "efis-summary"
)] |> 
  map_dfr(\(.tbl) {
    .tbl |>
      dplyr::filter(
        data_year == Inf,
        ut_name == "York R"
      ) |>  
      dplyr::select(
        ut_name, 
        channel,
        data_range,
        headline_gap_pc,
        headline_gap_total
      ) 
  }) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    summarize(., 
      channel = "Z) Total",
      data_range = "(2015-2024)",
      headline_gap_pc = sum(headline_gap_pc, na.rm = TRUE),
      headline_gap_total = sum(headline_gap_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      .by = ut_name 
    )
  )

tbls[["combined-gap"]] |> 
  gt::gt() |> 
  gt::cols_hide(
    c(ut_name)
  ) |> 
  gt::cols_label(
    channel = "Funding Channel",
    data_range = "Data Range",
    headline_gap_pc = "Per Capita Gap",
    headline_gap_total = "Annualized Total Gap"
  ) |> 
  gt::fmt_currency(
    columns = c(
      matches("^(headline_gap)")
    ), 
    decimals = 0
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_footnote(
    footnote = "For individual channels, Per Capita Gap is the annual average per-capita funding gap over the data range; The total row sums the per-capita gaps across channels", 
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(columns = c(headline_gap_pc))
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Annualized Total Gap is the product of Per Capita Gap and the average York Region population over the data range", 
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(columns = c(headline_gap_total))
  )

Show code
tbls[["combined-gap-detail"]] <- tbls[c(
  "fir-summary-core",
  "fir-summary-soc",
  "t3010-summary",
  "lhin-summary",
  "efis-summary"
)] |> 
  map_dfr(\(.tbl) {
    .tbl |>
      dplyr::filter(
        ut_name == "York R"
      ) |>  
      dplyr::select(
        ut_name,
        channel,
        data_year,
        data_range,
        headline_gap_pc,
        headline_gap_total
      ) |> 
      dplyr::mutate(
        observed_at = dplyr::case_when(
          data_year == Inf ~ "Annual Average",
          data_year == min(data_year[data_year < Inf]) ~ "Start Year",
          data_year == max(data_year[data_year < Inf]) ~ "End Year",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ) |> 
          factor(
            levels = c("Start Year", "End Year", "Annual Average")
          )
      ) |> 
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(observed_at)) |> 
      dplyr::select(-data_year)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    summarize(., 
      channel = "Z) Total",
      data_range = "(2015-2024)",
      headline_gap_pc = sum(headline_gap_pc, na.rm = TRUE),
      headline_gap_total = sum(headline_gap_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      .by = c(observed_at, ut_name)
    )
  ) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = observed_at,
    values_from = c(headline_gap_pc, headline_gap_total),
    names_glue = "{observed_at}::{.value}"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(
    ut_name,
    channel, 
    data_range, 
    matches("Start"),
    matches("End"), 
    matches("Annual")
  )

tbls[["combined-gap-detail"]] |>
  gt::gt() |> 
  gt::cols_hide(
    c(ut_name)
  ) |> 
  gt::cols_label(
    channel = "Funding Channel",
    data_range = "Data Range"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_label_with(
    columns = c(matches("gap_total$")), 
    fn = \(.x) {"TOT (mn)"}
  ) |> 
  gt::cols_label_with(
    columns = c(matches("gap_pc$")), 
    fn = \(.x) {"PC ($)"}
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_spanner_delim(
    delim = "::"
  ) |> 
  gt::fmt_currency(
    columns = c(
      matches("headline_gap_pc")
    ), 
    decimals = 0
  ) |> 
  gt::fmt_currency(
    columns = c(
      matches("headline_gap_total")
    ), 
    scale_by = 1e-6,
    decimals = 0
  ) |> 
  gt::text_replace(
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      columns = c(channel)
    ), 
    pattern = "Poverty Relief and Community Resources",
    replacement = "PR + CR"
  )
